english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being rude or offending someone, especially when the insult may be unintended.
This is the all-purpose choice when you offend or insult someone.
Use 得罪 when shocking someone means offending them or causing personal resentment.

examples.english: I didn't mean to insult you, so please don't take what I just said to heart.
examples.traditional: 我唔係有心要得罪你，啱啱講嗰句你唔好介意。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 jiu3 dak1 zeoi6 nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 gong2 go2 geoi3 nei5 m4 hou2 gaai3 ji3

examples.english: I didn't mean to offend you by saying that.
examples.traditional: 我唔係有心講呢句說話得罪你。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 gong2 ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 dak1 zeoi6 nei5

examples.english: I didn't mean to shock you; I was just telling the truth.
examples.traditional: 我唔係有心要得罪你，我只係講真話。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 jiu3 dak1 zeoi6 nei5 ngo5 zi2 hai6 gong2 zan1 waa6
